messages:
alerts-bot: [ALERT] prod-gateway high-5xx-rate — 502/504 spike detected. 5xx rate=8.1% (threshold 2%). Creating incident. See: https://redwood.ops/incident/3378901234 :rotating_light:

beth_oncall: grabbing it. first look — edge/gw pods in us-west are showing 502 bursts, CPU fine, but backend latency up. any quick wins?

raj_sre: quick note: traces are sparse for these requests. most logs lack request_id/span_id — sampling looks effectively 0 for edge tier (config drift after last agent rollout).

eva_prod: CS already flagging timeouts on /v1/chat/stream for multiple customers, some retries from SDK. customer-impact flag P1. cc @sam_support

sam_support: pinged top customers with the short blurb, they're seeing partial responses and retries. Ticket created: CS-4312. ETA for update: 20m.

beth_oncall: plan: 1) immediate routing mitigation (shift a fraction to standby region) 2) enable short-lived debug/tracing override to capture problem requests 3) communicate. Starting step 1 now — 10% traffic to us-west-standby.

deploy-bot: traffic-split update accepted: service/prod-gateway set split=90/10 -> us-west/us-west-standby. rollout in progress.

raj_sre: before we touch more, observability gap detail: logging-agent v2 failed on 3 of 6 edge nodes in earlier deploy (seen in kube events). Means even if we enable sampling, collector not accepting spans from those nodes. need stopgap trace shim.

beth_oncall: stopgap idea: enable proxy debug logs (non-blocking), and set TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 on edge pods for 10–15m. If collector isn't up on some nodes, also enable request-id header forwarding to ensure logs we DO have can be stitched.

raj_sre: agreed. applying env patch to daemonset (targeting node-group: edge-a only) to avoid full fleet churn. command:

```
kubectl -n prod set env daemonset/proxy LOG_LEVEL=debug TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 --selector=node-group=edge-a
```

deploy-bot: rollout started -> 2/3 edge-a pods patched (1 pending image pull).

beth_oncall: enabling request-id forwarder at ingress config now (will not require pod restart). patching configmap: `proxy-config: forward_request_id=true`

raj_sre: good — logs now start showing request_id for requests that hit patched nodes. still no spans from nodes that missed the agent rollout. we can temporarily route those nodes' traffic away by changing node selector on gateway pods to exclude faulty nodes, but that's heavier.

eva_prod: customer-impact numbers: ~1.2k failed requests/min, 37 customers effected, some saw repeated 502s. CS escalated one enterprise customer (acct-998) to SE team.

sam_support: sending follow-up note to impacted customers with mitigation steps and ETA.

beth_oncall: trying less destructive: spin up a local debug collector with lower resource, expose internal endpoint and set TRACER_ENDPOINT to it on patched pods. This will capture spans even if global collector is flaky.

raj_sre: go ahead. command to patch (examples):

```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/prod-gateway TRACER_ENDPOINT=http://debug-collector.prod.svc:9411
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/debug-collector --replicas=2
```

deploy-bot: debug-collector scaled -> 2/2 ready.

raj_sre: after pointing patched pods at debug-collector we see spans for ~60% of traced requests. still missing from the 3 nodes that never got logging-agent, but we at least have request_id in logs which helps reconstruct.

beth_oncall: I'm enabling a short-term higher sampling for the main service: `TRACE_OVERRIDE=always` via configmap toggle for 15m. will revert automatically with TTL.

raj_sre: note — a root cause hint: the agent rollout failed due to imagePullBackoff from new registry path (mirror deprecation). ops infra already has an open PR to fallback to previous mirror, but that won't help this incident immediately.

eva_prod: doc the customer-facing timeline in the incident doc. I'll update notes and CS ticket.

sam_support: updated customers with next update window + link to status page. responses are calmer now.

beth_oncall: quick health check: 5xx rate down to 3.4% after routing + debug shims. still above threshold but trending down. keeping the tracing overrides for another 10m.

raj_sre: action items so far: 1) revert bad agent image tag (infra) 2) permanent fix for tracer env propagation (infra + platform) 3) add prefer-fallback mirror to rollout scripts 4) create runbook step: if logging-agent rollout fails, autoset TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 and spin debug collector.

beth_oncall: handoff note for morning shift @ana_oncall — summary below. will leave incident in 'war room' for visibility.

beth_oncall: HANDOFF -> @ana_oncall (morning) — summary:
- symptom: prod-gateway 502/504 surge at 15:10 UTC, 5xx peaked ~8%.
- mitigation taken: traffic split 90/10 to standby, env patch TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 on edge-a, enabled request-id forwarding, spun up debug-collector and set TRACER_ENDPOINT to it, increased proxy logs to debug.
- current state: 5xx=3.4% and falling, debug collector capturing spans for patched pods, request_id present in logs for majority of requests. customers being notified.
- outstanding: fix broken logging-agent rollout on 3 nodes (imagePullBackoff -> mirror path), reconcile traces from nodes that never shipped spans, follow up infra PR for mirror fallback, add runbook item.

beth_oncall: outstanding owners: infra (fix agent image mirrors) -> @raj_sre following up with infra team; platform -> add runbook (beth + raj); cs -> continue comms (sam).

ana_oncall: (typo)

ana_oncall: sorry, meant @ana_oncall — acknowledging handoff, will take primary after 07:00 PT and follow up on outstanding infra fixes.

raj_sre: leaving a short debug log excerpt here for postmortem:

```
2026-03-15T15:18:02Z prod-gateway[proxy]: request_id= - missing header,  upstream_status=502, path=/v1/chat/stream
2026-03-15T15:18:05Z prod-gateway[proxy]: request_id=abc123, span_id= - collector_error=connection refused
2026-03-15T15:18:12Z debug-collector[0]: received span for request_id=abc123, duration=412ms
```

beth_oncall: I'll file the postmortem and include recommended runbook updates + timeline. handing fully to @ana_oncall. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
